findings.title: SaffronERC20StakingPool.add_liquidity(uint256,ISaffronBase.Tranche) uses a dangerous strict equality
findings.description:
A strict equality on a balance or amount can be broken by someone sending a little extra, locking the logic. Slither: SaffronERC20StakingPool.add_liquidity(uint256,ISaffronBase.Tranche) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1050-1078) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- require(bool,string)(epoch == 18,v1.18: only epoch 18 only) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1055)

findings.title: SaffronERC20StakingPool.add_liquidity(uint256,ISaffronBase.Tranche) uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: SaffronERC20StakingPool.add_liquidity(uint256,ISaffronBase.Tranche) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1050-1078) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(epoch == 18,v1.18: only epoch 18 only) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1055)

findings.title: SaffronERC20StakingPool.wind_down_epoch(uint256,uint256) uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: SaffronERC20StakingPool.wind_down_epoch(uint256,uint256) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1082-1097) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(epoch < current_epoch,cannot wind down future epoch) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1086)
	- require(bool,string)(block.timestamp >= get_epoch_end(previous_epoch),can't call before epoch ended) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1089)

findings.title: SaffronERC20StakingPool.shutdown() uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: SaffronERC20StakingPool.shutdown() (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1168-1172) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(block.timestamp > get_epoch_end(1) - 86400,trying to shutdown too early) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1170)

findings.title: SaffronERC20StakingPool.get_current_epoch() uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: SaffronERC20StakingPool.get_current_epoch() (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1190-1193) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(block.timestamp > epoch_cycle.start_date,before epoch 0) (SaffronERC20StakingPool.sol#1191)
